parameters.query:
SELECT c.id AS "conexaoId", c."contaId", c.access_token
FROM public."SAAS_Conexões" c
WHERE COALESCE(c."apiOficial", false) = true
  AND (
    (NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND c."phone_number_id" = $1::text)
    OR (NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND c.waba_id = $2::text)
  )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c."phone_number_id" = $1::text THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 1;
